comment: M2-DOCTR-QUAL thresholds — user ruling 2026-09-30 (binds the formal qualification run). Primary judging = coverage on production merged blocks with production pad (MERGE_PAD_PX=6) as the FORMAL result; pad-offset (strip 6px) reported alongside as diagnostic. Precision is a POLLUTION-BOUNDED OBSERVATION ONLY (SFX/background-text annotation blind spot) and is NOT a gate. Recognition outputs are never consulted.
pad_protocol: production_pad_6px_is_formal; pad-offset (strip 6px per side) reported as diagnostic

non_gate_observations.precision_note: pollution-bounded lower bound (GT blind spot: SFX/background text unannotated); reported, never gates

severe_page_miss_definition: on the primary layer (block_coverage): a region with >= severe_page_miss_min_gt GT boxes and zero matched detections; rate is over regions that contain at least one GT box
